content.text: {"sections":[{"section":"summary","body":"Nimbusfield Security is compliant with all of its covenants on the Venture Term Loan for the period ended October 31, 2026, and the compliance certificate agrees with the bank's calculation in each case. The most important change is cash burn. Runway has fallen below the bank's watch level, and the cushion on both the runway and unrestricted cash covenants has narrowed each month since August. Revenue is ahead of plan, so the pressure appears to come from spending rather than sales. The high-severity runway signal has been acknowledged, and no work items remain open for decision."},{"section":"covenants","body":"Minimum Runway is compliant at {{fact:5e075111-4594-4eda-9eeb-b1d483aab321}} months against a required {{fact:caaa8855-1488-43ab-a0d9-d277f5ee9bea}} months, a cushion of {{fact:817703a5-ed3c-49e1-b9c0-55b878918d35}}. Minimum Unrestricted Cash is compliant at {{fact:1300f6f3-f9f0-4192-86c7-2b2024c61b06}} against a required {{fact:f59c1e75-ca5d-4e05-a55c-f4d06b43784c}}, a cushion of {{fact:71bf8060-93da-4884-a4a3-fae49d106867}}. Revenue to Plan is compliant at {{fact:c113aae2-3896-4363-909b-a6c665eb7f7c}} against a floor of {{fact:c19644d5-7664-4763-b0b6-a0c4ceb67a4d}}, a cushion of {{fact:83a42716-5b75-41e8-a15f-2e31b29bc907}}. The certificate reports {{fact:2e37ad7a-aa87-45d3-9be4-fc82730fbedb}}, {{fact:d6275656-0a5c-4246-b761-f95780fc3ca7}} and {{fact:8804b673-8df9-4b9c-b67d-0c9b9233e4be}} respectively, matching the bank's calculations."},{"section":"risks","body":"The most significant signal is a high-severity alert that runway has fallen below the watch level. The system describes this as a sustained decline rather than a one-off, and the signal has been acknowledged. Separate low-severity signals relate to the same cash burn. Runway covenant cushion has fallen each month from August to {{fact:817703a5-ed3c-49e1-b9c0-55b878918d35}} in October, and the system projects it would be exhausted soon if the pace continues. Cash covenant cushion has fallen to {{fact:71bf8060-93da-4884-a4a3-fae49d106867}} over the same period. Revenue to Plan cushion is essentially flat, which is a mitigating point. Reviewers should focus on the burn trend, because the bank holds no burn or funding facts for this period."}]}
